title: Nominalization Chains with során, révén, and miatt

sections.title: Instrumentality and Process: révén and során
sections.content: To express HOW or DURING WHAT PROCESS a historical result was achieved, B2 Hungarian attaches postpositions like révén ('through / by means of'), során ('during / in the course of'), and miatt ('because of') to possessed -ás/-és nominalizations: az új kifejezések megalkotása révén ('through the creation of new expressions'), a kéziratok átdolgozása során ('in the course of revising the manuscripts').

sections.title: Double Possessive Nominalization Chains
sections.content: A nominalization can govern another possessed noun phrase in a three-element genitive chain: [a nemzet esztétikai ízlésének] [a nemesítése] ('the ennobling of the aesthetic taste of the nation'). Notice that the first inner possessor takes the dative-genitive suffix -nak/-nek when a second possessed head follows.

sections.title: Complex Nominalization + Postposition Patterns
rows: because of his participation in the movement
by means of creating new words
in the course of revising the manuscripts
the ennobling of the nation's aesthetic taste

items.spanish: Kazinczy a fiatal tehetségek bátorítása és az új kifejezések megalkotása révén formálta az irodalmat.
items.english: Kazinczy shaped literature by encouraging young talents and creating new expressions.

items.spanish: A jakobinus mozgalomban való részvétele miatt több mint hat évet töltött várbörtönben.
items.english: Because of his participation in the Jacobin movement, he spent more than six years in fortress prisons.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: When linking a case-marked complement (like mozgalomban) to a nominalized noun (részvétele), insert való ('being') between them: a mozgalomban való részvétele.
